name: Meeting - Book Meeting Room

parameters.query: SELECT id FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_rooms WHERE id = $1::uuid AND is_active = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings b WHERE b.room_id = $1::uuid AND b.status != 'CANCELLED' AND ($4::text = '' OR b.id::text != $4::text) AND tstzrange(b.start_time, b.end_time) && tstzrange($2::timestamptz, $3::timestamptz));

INSERT INTO {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings (id, room_id, organizer_id, title, start_time, end_time, status, description) VALUES (COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text, '')::uuid, uuid_generate_v4()), $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz, 'SCHEDULED', $6) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.room_id}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.organizer_id || '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.title}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.start_time}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.end_time}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.agenda || $('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.description || ''}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.id || ''}}

parameters.query: SELECT name, capacity FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_rooms WHERE id = $1::uuid;

parameters.responseBody: ={"success": false, "error": "Phòng họp không khả dụng trong khung giờ này."}
